_comment: Exp 40: infrastructure gate under reference_runner_v2. Target is the §17 feedback channel module (bench/dm/_feedback.py, ~22K). This is the first decomposed target element from the 14-sub-experiment series. Exp 40 maps to Exp 39-0 (infrastructure gate) but with (a) right-sized test article, (b) §17 + §18 directives live, (c) γ-alt convergence path wired, (d) specialist cells for math/stats/bio/info-sci live-promoted, (e) Macrophage verdict-wiring fallback, (f) DeepSeek '### Finding N:' header adapter, (g) fingerprint update quality-gated.

_convergence_criteria.description: Gate passes if: (a) all 5 models produce parseable output with R_k, (b) γ-alt path triggers at γ ≥ 0.30 OR 3 rounds zero novel CRITICAL, (c) R_k adoption ≥ 80% across models, (d) §17 and §18 admissibility rates logged. Wall-clock cap is a safety net, not the expected termination path.
_convergence_criteria.pass_condition: gamma >= 0.30 OR (3 consecutive rounds with 0 novel CRITICAL findings). Gamma-alt implemented in reference_runner_v2._check_gamma_alt_convergence.
_convergence_criteria.fail_condition: Any model fails to produce parseable output in 2+ consecutive rounds.

_directives_live._note: F2 (2026-04-21): eta_int_modulator wiring pulled forward from Exp 54 to Exp 40 under shadow-promotion-now policy. Wrapper runs in identity mode (m_div=1.0, c_ext=0, nu_k=0, d=1, p=1, eta_int=q) at bench/reference_runner_v2.py:3510; mathematically equivalent to the prior bare compute_rk(q) path but exercises the wrapper's channel validation. 1620-case identity verified in re-audit 2026-04-20.

_payload_note: _feedback.py=22K + _types.py=30K = 52K total. Under 80K threshold. All 5 models receive monolithic dispatch. No pre-decomposition expected.
_sequence_note: Exp 40 is the first of 14 single-target experiments (40-53) derived from Exp 39 sub-experiments 39-0 through 39-M. Lessons from Exp 40 fold into Exp 41's runner config. Exp 54 is the integration run with 2×2 factorial for §17/§18 attribution.
